description: Finds a person's likely work email from their name and company domain. Checks the domain's mail servers, reads the company's homepage and contact pages for addresses it publishes to learn its pattern (jane.doe, jdoe, jane), and ranks candidates with a confidence each. An exact address found on the site comes first. No SMTP probe. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

name.description: Person's first and last name (Jane Doe)
